films.title: Into the Wild
films.note: Re-watched on a rainy evening in Gushaini. An enduring reflection on Alaskan wilderness, radical simplicity, and the core truth that happiness is only real when shared.
films.trailConnection: 📍 Screened on a quiet laptop evening beside the Tirthan river in Seraj valley.

films.title: The Secret Life of Walter Mitty
films.note: Longboards across Icelandic fjords and walking into the Afghan mountain pass just to see a snow leopard. A tribute to unhurried presence.
films.trailConnection: 📍 Watched at a cafe in Dharamkot while writing bus dispatches.

films.title: Paterson
films.note: Jim Jarmusch's slow masterpiece on a city bus driver who writes poems during his shifts. The dignity of quiet observation and ordinary routine.
films.trailConnection: 📍 Reflected upon on the 9-hour ordinary HRTC bus ride from Mandi to Shimla.

films.title: Drive My Car
films.note: Adapted from Haruki Murakami's 'Men Without Women' (which I carry in the rucksack). Hours spent talking inside a vintage red Saab on long coastal highways.
films.trailConnection: 📍 Watched in Bir after finishing the story collection on the paragliding landing ground.
